entries.dialogueText: “I always keep my end of the bargain, Mr. President. Don't forget.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“You had better keep yours as well...."
entries.dialogueText: “You had better keep yours as well.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Before we end the call, there is a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Before we end the call, there is actually one more thing I would like to discuss.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“No. We don't.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No. We don't.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“As long as we both understand what..."
entries.dialogueText: “As long as we both understand what entails *not* being enemies.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cleared his throat."
entries.dialogueText: He cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Since the start of your campaign,..."
entries.dialogueText: “Since the start of your campaign, you've wisely committed to a market economy."

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Judging by that, I am sure you are..."
entries.dialogueText: “Judging by that, I am sure you are looking into privatizing some of the companies that are currently state owned.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I believe, therefore, that privati..."
entries.dialogueText: “I believe, therefore, that privatizing both Nedam Mining Group and the Sordish State Corporation would be in both of our interests.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“You are nothing!”"
entries.dialogueText: “You are nothing!”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I will destroy you and everything..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will destroy you and everything you hold dear.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Slowly.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Slowly.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Very slowly.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very slowly.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“After all, I am considering buying..."
entries.dialogueText: “After all, I am considering buying stocks in both companies.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That's exactly what I was thinking..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's exactly what I was thinking.”
entries.menuText: “That's exactly what I was thinking.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“You think I don't know?”"
entries.dialogueText: “You think I don't know?”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Be careful around the people you t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Be careful around the people you trust.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Screw you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Screw you.”
entries.menuText: “Screw you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't know what?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Don't know what?”
entries.menuText: “Don't know what?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He laughed again."
entries.dialogueText: He laughed again.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Excellent! Great minds do think al..."
entries.dialogueText: “Excellent! Great minds do think alike. Thank you for your support.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Privatizing both might be too much..."
entries.dialogueText: “Privatizing both might be too much. I will see what I can do.”
entries.menuText: “Privatizing both might be too much. I will see what I can do.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Think about it this way. It is ano..."
entries.dialogueText: “Think about it this way. It is another step forward in strengthening our economy.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am not thinking about privatizat..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am not thinking about privatization.”
entries.menuText: “I am not thinking about privatization.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Please at least think about it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Please at least think about it.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“What do you mean? You will leave e..."
entries.dialogueText: “What do you mean? You will leave everything the same, then?”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Don't tell me you are thinking abo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't tell me you are thinking about nationalization?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes, I am.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, I am.”
entries.menuText: “Yes, I am.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Mr. President. Nationalization as..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Nationalization as a concept goes against everything my father built and stood for.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm thinking about a more balanced..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm thinking about a more balanced approach.”
entries.menuText: “I'm thinking about a more balanced approach.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Balance is important, Mr. Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: “Balance is important, Mr. President, but the concept of nationalization goes against everything my father built and stood for.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Before we end the call, there is a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Before we end the call, there is actually one more thing I would like to discuss.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cleared his throat."
entries.dialogueText: He cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I will be blunt.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I will be blunt.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Mr. Tusk is unfit to be the spokes..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Tusk is unfit to be the spokesperson for the Lotherberg Group. His archaic thinking has only preserved a status quo that benefits himself and precious few others."

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“It is high time something changed...."
entries.dialogueText: “It is high time something changed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I see where this is going.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I see where this is going.”
entries.menuText: “I see where this is going.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Who do you have in mind to replace..."
entries.dialogueText: “Who do you have in mind to replace him?”
entries.menuText: “Who do you have in mind to replace him?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Stop. Before you say anything more..."
entries.dialogueText: “Stop. Before you say anything more, I won't meddle in Oligarchs' affairs.”
entries.menuText: “Stop. Before you say anything more, I won't meddle in Oligarchs' affairs.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Ah, it was worth a shot. But I res..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ah, it was worth a shot. But I respect your decision.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Very well. I won't push further.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. I won't push further.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I want him gone.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I want him gone.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Who do you think?""
entries.dialogueText: “Who do you think?"

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Me, of course!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Me, of course!”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I have taken up enough of your tim..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have taken up enough of your time today.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Here is what I propose. A win-win..."
entries.dialogueText: “Here is what I propose. A win-win situation.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“It is time the group had a proper..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is time the group had a proper leader."

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Me.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Me.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“If you could use your powers to ma..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you could use your powers to make Bergia Steel, Tusk's main company, state-owned, he would lose considerable influence.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Which means I could take over.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Which means I could take over.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“If I take over with your help, I w..."
entries.dialogueText: “If I take over with your help, I will be forever indebted to you and support you in all your goals, be they re-election or something more.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“How does that sound?”"
entries.dialogueText: “How does that sound?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'll have to think about it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'll have to think about it.”
entries.menuText: “I'll have to think about it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That sounds profitable to me. Deal..."
entries.dialogueText: “That sounds profitable to me. Deal.”
entries.menuText: “That sounds profitable to me. Deal.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I won't make myself a target by pi..."
entries.dialogueText: “I won't make myself a target by picking a side.”
entries.menuText: “I won't make myself a target by picking a side.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Perfect!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Perfect!”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Just think about it. That's all I..."
entries.dialogueText: “Just think about it. That's all I am asking.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“You and me. We would be unstoppabl..."
entries.dialogueText: “You and me. We would be unstoppable. We could eliminate everyone who's after us.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Well then.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Well then.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“This has been a productive call.”"
entries.dialogueText: “This has been a productive call.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Thank you for your time, Mr. Presi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your time, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thanks Marcel. Talk to you later.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thanks Marcel. Talk to you later.”
entries.menuText: “Thanks Marcel. Talk to you later.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Goodbye, Mr. Koronti.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Goodbye, Mr. Koronti.”
entries.menuText: “Goodbye, Mr. Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I hung up the phone."
entries.dialogueText: I hung up the phone.
entries.menuText: Hang up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a couple of minutes, I went b..."
entries.dialogueText: After a couple of minutes, I went back to reviewing the agenda.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“If you promised me a majority of s..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you promised me a majority of shares from the privatization, he would lose considerable power.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: ""On another note...""
entries.dialogueText: "On another note..."

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: ""Moving on...""
entries.dialogueText: "Moving on..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You've outlived your usefulness to..."
entries.dialogueText: “You've outlived your usefulness to me. You are done for, Koronti.”
entries.menuText: “You've outlived your usefulness to me. You are done for, Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I understand. I want our partnersh..."
entries.dialogueText: “I understand. I want our partnership to continue uninterrupted.”
entries.menuText: “I understand. I want our partnership to continue uninterrupted.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“As do I.”"
entries.dialogueText: “As do I.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“You may recall that one of the ter..."
entries.dialogueText: “You may recall that one of the terms of our agreement was that I may ask you for one favor. Well, this is it."

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I want him gone. And you're going..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want him gone. And you're going to make it happen."
